## Bug

`quorum compass` was broken for all npm-installed users in v3.0.0.

`bin/commands/compass.js` imported from:
```
../../modules/compass/create.js
../../modules/compass/sources/index.js
../../modules/oracle/index.js
../../modules/oracle/adapters/lance-db.js
../../modules/oracle/adapters/xenova-embedder.js
```

These paths only exist as `.ts` files. Plain `node` cannot import them, so every `quorum compass` subcommand threw `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` on install.
